repo.description:
### Impact

File owners were unable to unlock `TYPE_TOKEN `locks placed by other users, leaving files permanently locked with no recovery path outside of the database.

### Patches

<!-- Adjust component name and version. "Nextcloud Enterprise" is only needed for Server and shipped apps -->

It is recommended that the Nextcloud Server is upgraded to 32.0.6 or 33.0.6 or 34.0.1
It is recommended that the Nextcloud Enterprise Server is upgraded to 32.0.6 or 33.0.6 or 34.0.1

### Workarounds

<!-- Remove not applicable sections -->

* Remove the file_lock directly in the database

### References

<!-- Link to the main/master PR only -->

* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/3770482)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/files_lock/pull/1168)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: Write-share collaborator can place a TYPE_TOKEN lock that permanently denies the file owner
